sentences.en: My name is Conor, and today with my co-host Bryce, we finish part two of our two-part interview with Andrei Alexandrescu.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天和我一起主持的是布莱斯，我们将完成对安德烈·亚历山德雷斯库的两部分访谈的第二部分。
zh_words: 安德烈·亚历山德雷斯库

sentences.en: Bryce, you mentioned this, like, I don't think I'm the best in every meeting or something like that, right?
sentences.zh: 布莱斯，你提到过这个，比如，我不觉得自己是每次会议里表现最好的，或者诸如此类，对吧？

sentences.en: You mentioned that.
sentences.zh: 你提到过这个。

sentences.en: It's kind of funny.
sentences.zh: 这挺有趣的。

sentences.en: So I have this interview question.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个面试问题。

sentences.en: So when I interview people, I was just, I worked for Symmetry Investments, this fintech company, and, you know, I had this interview question.
sentences.zh: 所以当我面试别人的时候，我刚刚，我曾在 Symmetry Investments 这家金融科技公司工作，你知道的，我有一个面试问题。

sentences.en: In a meeting, like, let's say you're at work in a meeting, what do you want to be in terms of skill?
sentences.zh: 在会议中，比方说你在工作中的一次会议上，就技能而言，你想成为什么样的人？

sentences.en: Do you want to be the best, the worst, or someone in the middle, right?
sentences.zh: 你想成为最好的、最差的，还是居中的人，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, it's actually interesting because I think I have two different answers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实这很有趣，因为我觉得我有两个不同的答案。

sentences.en: It used to be that when I was solely an individual contributor, my answer was I always want to be in the room with people that are smarter than me.
sentences.zh: 以前当我仅仅是一个独立贡献者时，我的回答是我总是想和比我聪明的人呆在同一个房间里。

sentences.en: And usually if I'm having, like, a typical meeting with, like, multiple people, you know, that is usually a meeting where, like,
sentences.zh: 通常如果我开一个，比如，有多个人的典型会议，你知道，那通常是一个会议，比如，

sentences.en: I want to be there with people that are going to educate me in some way.
sentences.zh: 我想和那些能在某种程度上教育我的人在一起。

sentences.en: But since I've moved into more of a leadership role, and I've always sort of over the years, I've always had some amount, some number of people that I have mentored in some way,
sentences.zh: 但自从我转向更多的领导角色后，而且这些年来我一直，我总是有一定数量的人，我以某种方式指导过他们，

sentences.en: shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 各种形式。

sentences.en: But I do a lot more of it these days.
sentences.zh: 但如今我做这方面的比例要多得多。

sentences.en: I have learned that it is incredible, like, I think one of the highest value things that I do is have one-on-one meetings with, like,
sentences.zh: 我了解到这真是不可思议，我认为我做的最高价值的事情之一就是与，比如，

sentences.en: the various members of my team and the other teams that I work with.
sentences.zh: 我团队的各个成员以及我与之合作的其他团队进行一对一的会议。

sentences.en: Especially the less senior members or the, you know, the members that I'm trying to encourage them to take on more responsibility and to grow into a bigger role.
sentences.zh: 尤其是资历较浅的成员，或者你知道的，那些我正试图鼓励他们承担更多责任并成长为更大角色的成员。

sentences.en: And I've started realizing that, you know, sometimes, like, I can have, like, a 30-minute or an hour-long meeting with somebody, and, like, I can say one thing,
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到，有时，比如，我可以和某人进行 30 分钟或一小时的会议，并且，比如，我可以讲一句话，

sentences.en: and that will completely change, like, how they're going to operate for the next week.
sentences.zh: 那将彻底改变，比如，他们接下来一周的工作方式。

sentences.en: And, like, it'll lead to a much better outcome.
sentences.zh: 而且，比如，这会带来好得多的结果。

sentences.en: Huge impact.
sentences.zh: 巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So, you know, what would you answer, Connor?
sentences.zh: 那么，你知道的，康纳，你会怎么回答？

sentences.en: I would always prefer to be the least intelligent person in the room, because then, like, one of my biggest things that I'm after in life is, like, learning.
sentences.zh: 我总是更愿意成为房间里智商最低的人，因为那样的话，比如，我在生活中追求的最大目标之一就是学习。

sentences.en: I'm very curious, and I always want to be learning.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，并且我总是希望在学习。

sentences.en: And if you're the least intelligent, that doesn't mean you're unintelligent.
sentences.zh: 如果你是智商最低的，这并不意味着你智商不高。

sentences.en: It just means relative to the people in the room.
sentences.zh: 这只意味着相对于房间里的其他人而言。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That being said, like, I always want to be at a place where, like, I have the context and the tribal knowledge.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，比如，我总是想在一个我拥有背景知识和部落知识的地方。

sentences.en: Because there's, like, there's, you know, regardless of what your job title is, it's, like, those two different states where you're feeling like you're an imposter,
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，无论你的职位是什么，都有这两种不同的状态，你会觉得你像个冒名顶替者，

sentences.en: and people are assuming that you have a certain level of knowledge.
sentences.zh: 而大家假设你拥有一定水平的知识。

sentences.en: But it's, like, it's not that you don't have that knowledge.
sentences.zh: 但这就好像，并不是你没有那些知识。

sentences.en: It's that you can't contribute in – it's, like, I always have this metaphor of when you're trying to learn something, especially a programming language, you start out, and it's,
sentences.zh: 而是你无法参与其中——这就好比我一直有个隐喻，当你试图学习某样东西时，特别是编程语言，你刚开始时，它就好像，

sentences.en: like, this planet or something that you can't wrap your hands around.
sentences.zh: 是这个你无法一手掌握的星球或其他什么。

sentences.en: And then at a certain point, you sort of feel like you can palm it like a basketball, and then at a certain point, you feel like you can get your whole mind around it.
sentences.zh: 然后在某个时刻，你觉得自己可以像拿篮球一样把它单手抓起来，再到某个时刻，你觉得自己能彻底理解它。

sentences.en: And, like, languages like, you know, lisps are super easy to, like, you know, scheme.
sentences.zh: 而且，像某些语言，你知道的，Lisp 非常容易，比如，你知道的，Scheme。

sentences.en: You can learn in a day or two, and then you feel like you're a god, you know, operating at that language.
sentences.zh: 你可以在一两天内学会，然后你就会觉得自己像个神一样，你知道的，用那种语言操作。

sentences.en: But C++, I never feel like, you know, supposedly I'm an expert in the language, but, like, I never feel like I fully have my hands wrapped around it because it's just too large.
sentences.zh: 但对于 C++，我从不觉得，你知道的，虽然据说我是这门语言的专家，但是，我从不觉得我能完全把它一手掌握，因为它实在太庞大了。

sentences.en: It's changing too often.
sentences.zh: 它变化太频繁了。

sentences.en: And so –
sentences.zh: 所以——

sentences.en: Well, maybe Bjarne doesn't have his hands around it or her.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许比雅尼也没有把它们完全掌握或者她没有。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I mean, famously, what does he give himself, a 6 or 7 out of 10 or something, that there's some quote?
sentences.zh: 对，好吧，我的意思是，众所周知，他给自己打几分，10分里打6分或7分什么的，有这么个名言？

sentences.en: And then we've had this conversation offline that, like, even though you may feel like a 1 or 2 out of 10, that doesn't make you not an expert because, like, relative to, you know,
sentences.zh: 然后我们在线下讨论过，尽管你可能觉得自己只有 10 分里的 1 分或 2 分，但这并不代表你不是专家，因为，比如，相对于，你知道的，

sentences.en: the C++ engineers at large.
sentences.zh: 广大 C++ 工程师而言。

sentences.en: So, I guess my point here is less than being, like, the smartest or the least intelligent relative to the folks in the room, I always want to feel like I have, like,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想说的是，比起成为房间里最聪明或最不聪明的人，我总是希望自己觉得，比如，

sentences.en: I'm not missing out on the context or the tribal knowledge or, like, the assumed knowledge because that's when you're really able to, like, ask the questions and, like,
sentences.zh: 我没有错过背景知识、部落知识或所谓的默认知识，因为只有那样，你才能真正地去提问，并，比如，

sentences.en: feel comfortable.
sentences.zh: 感到舒适。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Know what to ask.
sentences.zh: 知道该问什么。

sentences.en: And, like, there's always, like, a certain period of time when you join a company.
sentences.zh: 而且，比如，当你加入一家公司时，总会有那么一段时间。

sentences.en: And that's, like, that's one of the hardest things.
sentences.zh: 而那是，比如，最难的事情之一。

sentences.en: Like, when I switched from my first company that I worked for four or five years at,
sentences.zh: 比如，当我离开我工作了四五年的第一家公司时，

sentences.en: you get to this place where you have all that knowledge and you're the person in the room that knows the questions to ask and the things to bring up.
sentences.zh: 你会到达这样一个地方：你拥有所有的知识，你就是房间里知道该问什么问题、该提出什么事情的那个人。

sentences.en: And then when you switch to a new company, you're giving up all of that tribal knowledge.
sentences.zh: 然后当你跳槽到一家新公司时，你要放弃所有这些部落知识。

sentences.en: And in some companies, like, some of it is more transferable if it's, like, you know, standard C++ and you're going to another company.
sentences.zh: 在某些公司里，有些知识是更容易迁移的，如果它是，比如，你知道的标准 C++ 并且你要去另一家公司的话。

sentences.en: But at my first company, it was all just this very, very narrow sort of actuarial, you know, domain knowledge that is just, you know,
sentences.zh: 但在我的第一家公司，这一切都只是非常非常狭隘的精算类，你知道的，领域知识，以至于，你知道的，

sentences.en: all of that expertise just goes poof and you're not really bringing it.
sentences.zh: 所有的这些专业知识都化为乌有了，你并没有真正带走它们。

sentences.en: And it's hard to, like, go from a place where you're kind of, you know, the expert or one of the experts in the room and then being to the person that needs to go back to square,
sentences.zh: 而且很难从一个你有点像是，你知道的，房间里的专家或其中一个专家的地方，变成那个需要回到原点的人，

sentences.en: you know, not zero.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，不是零。

sentences.en: But I do follow the Chris Lattner philosophy, though, that he's always, you know, trying to surround him with people that know way more about their top, you know,
sentences.zh: 不过我的确遵循克里斯·拉特纳的哲学，他总是，你知道的，试图让自己周围的人比他更了解他们的主题，你知道的，

sentences.en: their domain than he does, because then he can just leech off of them.
sentences.zh: 比他更了解他们的领域，因为这样他就可以从他们身上汲取养分。

sentences.en: I love these answers.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这些回答。

sentences.en: And, you know, Bryce mentioned the whole mentoring aspect, and that's wonderful.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，布莱斯提到了整个指导（mentoring）方面，这太棒了。

sentences.en: And the whole, like, sharing.
sentences.zh: 还有整个分享的过程。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is, like, really a nice thing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这真的是一件很棒的事。

sentences.en: Like, this one thing you can say that completely changed, like, you know, Dostoyevsky manner changes completely the life of the, you know, the person you're mentoring.
sentences.zh: 比如，你说的这件小事完全改变了，你知道的，陀思妥耶夫斯基式的方式彻底改变了你所指导的人的生活。

sentences.en: And I think that's awesome.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太棒了。

sentences.en: And, Connor, you mentioned this, like, I want to, you know, I want to be somewhere in the middle, kind of have the tribal knowledge, but also have people to learn from.
sentences.zh: 而且，康纳，你提到了这个，比如，我想，你知道的，我想找个居中的地方，既有部落知识，又有可以学习的人。

sentences.en: Well, you folks, you would be shocked at how many folks walk into that interview and ask them this question and they answer, I want to be the best in every meeting.
sentences.zh: 好吧，各位，你们会震惊于有多少人走进面试并被问到这个问题时，他们的回答是：我希望在每次会议中都表现得最好。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's no, in a way, there's no wrong answer to this question, but I think they wouldn't realize just how boring that life would be.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，从某种意义上说，这个问题没有错误的答案，但我认为他们没有意识到那种生活会有多无聊。

sentences.en: It definitely would mean they're in the wrong employment, they're in the wrong place,
sentences.zh: 那绝对意味着他们选错了职业，去错了地方，

sentences.en: because you don't want to be in a place where they're the best at everything and have nobody to learn from anything.
sentences.zh: 因为你不会想去一个你在所有事情上都是最好、没有人可以向其学习任何东西的地方。

sentences.en: You know, so definitely it's, it's not a good, it's not a good place to be in the long term.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以从长远来看，这绝对不是一个好地方，不是一个好去处。

sentences.en: So, you know, that also harkens back to the whole discussion of humility and, you know, a necessary quality of a programmer.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这也让人回想起关于谦逊的整个讨论，你知道的，这是程序员必不可少的品质。

sentences.en: So, good stuff, you folks.
sentences.zh: 所以，说得好，各位。

sentences.en: Hey, I want to discuss politics.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我想讨论政治。

sentences.en: Are you upset?
sentences.zh: 你们难过吗？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Here we go, folks.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧，各位。

sentences.en: This is where our PG-13 podcast is going to have an explicit rating for henceforth.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们这个 PG-13 播客从今以后要被打上限制级标签的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, take your kids to sleep upstairs, you know, close the door and let's talk politics.
sentences.zh: 对，让你们的孩子上楼睡觉去，你知道的，关上门，我们来聊聊政治。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm not, you know, I'm not here to kind of ask you what, you know, who you voted for, whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我不是，你知道的，我不是来问你，你知道的，你投了谁的票，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: And I'm going to say I'm desperately trying to stay centrist, but centrist, being in a center seems to be nowadays, nobody believes you.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，我正拼命试图保持中立，但是中立，处在中间似乎在如今看来，没人会相信你。

sentences.en: Like, if you talk to someone on either side, they're going to assume you're on the bad side and, you know, that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你和任何一方的人交谈，他们都会假设你站在邪恶的一方，你知道的，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: But I just, I don't want to discuss politics per se as much as the impact of politics on the new generation of programmers.
sentences.zh: 但我只是，我不想去讨论政治本身，而是想讨论政治对新一代程序员的影响。

sentences.en: Because I have this feeling that there may be some cross-talk, some influence.
sentences.zh: 因为我有这种感觉，可能存在一些跨界交流，一些影响。

sentences.en: And here's my take.
sentences.zh: 以下是我的看法。

sentences.en: It is my opinion that in the last few years, let's say, and not only in the States, but globally, there's been an increasing relativization of the truth.
sentences.zh: 依我之见，在过去几年里，比方说，不仅在美国，在全球范围内，对真相的相对化一直在加剧。

sentences.en: An increasing, you know, actually, in the whole, like, the alternative facts, like, the fact that this phrase was even uttered on, like, in public.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的，你知道的，实际上，在整个过程中，比如另类事实，甚至在公开场合说出这个短语的事实。

sentences.en: The sheer fact that somebody with political acumen mentioned there's alternative facts and there's alternative facts.
sentences.zh: 某个具政治头脑的人提到存在另类事实以及另类事实，仅凭这个事实本身就足够惊人了。

sentences.en: And the sheer fact that this phrase got even said is a huge deal for sciences, for everything that's hard science, everything that is programming, everything that's engineering.
sentences.zh: 这个短语甚至被说出来这一纯粹的事实，对科学、对所有硬科学、对所有编程、对所有工程学来说都是一件大事。

sentences.en: And I wonder, somebody who grows up in such an environment in which, you know, the truth is pretty much, you can, you can, you can work it out.
sentences.zh: 我在想，在一个这样的环境中成长起来的人，你知道的，真相基本上是，你可以，你可以，你可以自己去得出它。

sentences.en: You can work out your own truth if you don't, if you don't like the, you know, whatever the real facts indicate.
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢，你知道的，无论真实的事实表明什么，你都可以得出你自己的真相。

sentences.en: I fear that there's going to be a problem with, like, in, you know, five years from now, and all of these kids who actually missed a lot of school.
sentences.zh: 我担心五年后会出现一个问题，比如，所有这些实际上错过了很多学校教育的孩子们。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, yet another issue, right?
sentences.zh: 而那是，你知道的，又一个问题，对吧？

sentences.en: They missed a lot of school for, you know, for a variety of reasons related to COVID, right?
sentences.zh: 由于与新冠疫情相关的各种原因，他们错过了很多学校教育，对吧？

sentences.en: Missed a lot of school, missed a lot of hard science preparation, and grew in this environment where actually truth is, is not an absolute, you know, is not an absolute reference.
sentences.zh: 错过了很多学校教育，错过了许多硬科学的准备，并在这样一个环境中长大：在这里，真相实际上不是一个绝对的，你知道的，不是一个绝对的参照物。

sentences.en: And how do you get to program a computer where actually if you, if one bit is out of place, it's kind of, it goes berserk, right?
sentences.zh: 你如何去为计算机编程呢？在这里，实际上只要有一个比特放错了位置，它就会发疯，对吧？

sentences.en: There's no, absolutely nothing, there's no telling what's going to happen if one bit is in the wrong place, right?
sentences.zh: 绝对没有，根本无法预料如果一个比特在错误的位置会发生什么，对吧？

sentences.en: So, you know, I just wanted to ask you about, what's your take about this?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我只是想问问你们，对此你们有什么看法？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's an interesting question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这是一个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I think that, yeah, I definitely think the current generation that's had some amount of, like, their schooling where they've been, like, during the pandemic, like,
sentences.zh: 我觉得，是的，我绝对认为当前这一代人在大流行期间经历过某种学校教育的人，比如，

sentences.en: there's going to be, we're going to see that five, ten years from now.
sentences.zh: 这将会在五到十年后显现出来。

sentences.en: But one, I think one interesting thing has changed since when Connor and I were in school, which is, and maybe it's even not the case for Connor, but when I was in, like,
sentences.zh: 但有一点，我认为自康纳和我上学以来有一件有趣的事情发生了变化，那就是，也许对康纳来说并非如此，但当我在，比如，

sentences.en: school before college, like, all my schooling before college, there was never any courses, like, programming courses.
sentences.zh: 上大学之前的学校时，比如，我大学之前的所有学校教育中，从来没有任何课程，比如编程课程。

sentences.en: It was not an option.
